scope: 2024 ICPC ECFinal A G I K
limitations: Small-case independent checks; no online submissions or maximum-scale timing.

A.method: 2000 random interval families of 3/6/9/12 items versus exhaustive triple partitions and returned grouping checks

G.method: all coprime A,B through 17 and starts below 200 versus exact cycle simulation

I.method: all labeled trees with 2/4/6 vertices plus 200 random even trees, all simple paths and color balance

K.method: 3750 connected-graph boundary requests against every connected exploration order, then actual Dijkstra for constructed weights
